main_text.l: Addo, cur tumeant audaci pectora fastu,
Quum tenuis fumus, pulvis & umbra fiem?
Vrget propositum rigidus subigitque rebellem,
Pressus sæpe manus cogor & arma dare.
Quid faciam? quo me subnixus vindice tuter?
Quis certum imbelli iam ferat auxilium?
Sed mihi, serpentis qui vafri, Christe, dolosas
Artes vicisti, solus adesse velis.
Nam si consilium virésque in prælia mittas,
Vincetur subito qui modo victor erat.
IN LIBRVM IOANNIS
De Leri, quo Americæ hi-
storiam descripsit.
IGnotas quondam, & nostro procul orbe remotas
Gentes, monstrosa barbarieque feras,
Stridentesque sonos linguæ, ventresque nefandos
Humanis saturos carnibus ecce refers.
Credo, equidem, Lerae, doces nam visa: sed euge
Te dignum nodum vindice solve precor.
Talia, dic, portenta hominum tam rara benigni
Temperies cæli num generare queat:
Et quos inculta mites creat arbore fructus
Mite solum, indomita fertilitate nitens?
Ꝑ. Horrida monstra hominum quaris num gignat
amæna
Temperies cæli, fertilitásque soli?

page.notes: Doubtful readings: "fiem" (line 2 of first poem; possibly "fiam" or "siem"), "quaris" (possibly "quaeris"), "subnixus" (print reads "fubnixus"), "Ꝑ." (the leading mark before "Horrida" is uncertain; it may be a reference or sign). The initial "I" is a large woodcut initial joined to "Gnotas". Right-hand edge shows faint show-through from the facing page, not transcribed.
